newsitem.title: USA: Hercules sees $550 mln value from Tastemaker.
newsitem.headline: Hercules sees $550 mln value from Tastemaker.

text.p: Hercules Inc said Wednesday it expects to realize a net cash value of $550 million from the sale of its 50-50 Tastemaker venture to Roche Holding Ltd.
Earlier, Mallinckrodt Inc, the other partner in the Tastemaker venture, said the deal also had a net value of $550 million for it.
Hercules said it will use the cash from the deal to repurchase shares.
The transaction is expected to close within 60 to 90 days, subject to receiving necessary regulatory and other customary approvals.
"Since its formation, Tastemaker has been an outstanding performer and a strong contributor to Hercules' equity earnings," R. Keith Elliott, Hercules chairman, said in a statement.
Hercules said its board of directors also authorized the continuation of a stock repurchase program, giving management authority to buy back up to 10 million shares.

Prior to this authorization, the Hercules board had authorized the repurchase of up to 65 million shares in the past six years. To date, Hercules has repurchased almost 55 million shares, or 39 percent of the shares outstanding.
